title: Activation clustering for backdoor detection
description: Cluster the last-layer activations of each class's training examples; poisoned examples form a small separate cluster.

source.title: Detecting Backdoor Attacks on Deep Neural Networks by Activation Clustering
source.authors: Chen, Carvalho, Baracaldo, Ludwig, Edwards, Lee, Molloy, Srivastava

reason: Needs the model's poisoned training set. The backdoor testbed gives defenders only 100 clean images, so there is nothing poisoned to cluster. A data-poisoning variant of the testbed (defender sees the training set) would fit.
verdict_source: idea declares no fitting testbed; reason recorded
